display.purpose: Identity statements, section chapters, and invitations.

body.purpose: Readable descriptions, project evidence, and résumé content.

title.purpose: Project and résumé hierarchy below the display scale.

label.purpose: Indices, metadata, and compact navigation signals.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift the résumé and assistant without glossy depth.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared confident deceleration for entrances and state changes.

motion.name: selector-duration
motion.purpose: Project selector hover and focus feedback.

components.name: Primary Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet fixed navigation with a rare oxide-red active signal.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--muted); font: 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="location"] { color: var(--text); background: linear-gradient(var(--accent), var(--accent)) no-repeat 0 78% / 100% 1px; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--text); outline: none; }

components.name: Project Selector
components.description: A rounded real-project preview that grows without shifting layout.
components.css: .ds-project-selector { display: grid; min-height: 240px; overflow: hidden; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .12); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--ink-soft); color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 200ms var(--ease-out), border-color 200ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-project-image { min-height: 150px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e9e5de, #96969d); } .ds-project-selector small { align-self: end; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-project-selector:hover, .ds-project-selector:focus-visible { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / .3); box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / .42); outline: none; transform: scale(1.03); }

components.name: AI Orb
components.description: Persistent circular access to the grounded portfolio assistant.
components.css: .ds-ai-orb { display: grid; width: 56px; height: 56px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .18); border-radius: 50%; background: #171719; color: var(--text); font-size: 24px; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / .42); transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), background 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-ai-orb:hover, .ds-ai-orb:focus-visible { background: #252527; outline: 1px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 3px; transform: scale(1.045); } .ds-ai-orb:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: AI Panel
components.description: A dark translucent conversational layer that stays subordinate to portfolio evidence.
components.html:
ASK SHIKUANG · AI

Answers are grounded in the résumé and portfolio.
components.css: .ds-ai-panel { width: min(400px, calc(100vw - 32px)); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .14); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: rgb(16 16 17 / .94); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(0 0 0 / .58); font: 14px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(125%); } .ds-ai-panel small { color: #c8675e; letter-spacing: .17em; } .ds-ai-panel button { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .16); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); } .ds-ai-panel button:hover, .ds-ai-panel button:focus-visible { border-color: var(--paper); outline: none; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Small uppercase evidence labels used in project chapters.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .14); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted); font: 650 9px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / .3); color: var(--text); outline: none; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a dark exhibition catalogue that has become interactive. The opening portrait is not a photograph laid under an effect: light and shadow are rebuilt from irregular particles, expressing the move from physical objects to intelligent systems. Interfaces remain restrained so the work, résumé, and evidence carry the experience.
keyCharacteristics: Complete project evidence rather than decorative thumbnails

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks orientation or action; it never becomes decoration or a large background field.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Serif is reserved for identity, chapter statements, and major contact invitations; functional UI stays sans-serif.

dos: Do let real project pages and the particle portrait provide visual richness.
Do preserve complete source documents, citations, keyboard paths, and reduced motion.
Do keep red scarce and functional.
Do use warm paper only as a deliberate résumé interruption inside the black world.
donts: Don't expose the portrait photo behind the particle canvas.
Don't add generic gradient cards, neon glow, glass tiles, or dashboard chrome.
Don't hide the main mobile navigation or let floating UI cover page controls.
Don't replace project evidence with summaries when full pages are available.
